message.content:
The cover of TEMPO magazine, dated "12-18 JULI 2021," features a large, stylized brown sphere with numerous dark-red, droplet-shaped protrusions, resembling a microscopic view of a virus. This giant sphere occupies most of the upper and middle sections. Positioned below and partially supporting this sphere is a male figure with short dark hair, wearing glasses and a light-colored, long-sleeved shirt tucked into dark trousers. He is shown in a hunched, straining posture, with one arm raised as if bracing against the weight of the sphere. His facial expression shows visible exertion, with gritted teeth and beads of sweat on his forehead.

The background is a flat, muted teal-grey. The top of the cover contains black text in Indonesian: "TERPIDANA MINIM FAKTA DI MEMPAWAH" and "LEBAH YANG TERANCAM PUNAH." Below the large black "TEMPO" logo, handwritten text reads "50 Tahun!". The main headline in bold white capital letters is "BISAKAH KITA BERTAHAN," followed by a paragraph of smaller white text regarding "Covid-19" and "oksigen." A barcode and QR code are visible in the bottom-left corner.
